label: PF Backlog 629
title: [Gate 2.5] skip_globs miss product-forge/-prefixed paths: docs-only changes falsely require architect-review evidence
body: architect_review.changed_files() returns repo-root-relative paths (e.g. product-forge/docs/documentation-index.html) but config/architect-review.json skip_globs are written as docs/**, **/*.md, config/**. The docs/** and config/** patterns do not match the product-forge/ prefix, so a generated-docs-only change (documentation-index.html) is treated as review-required and blocks precheck. Fix the globs to match both layouts without weakening the code/schema/security gate.

objective: Make Gate 2.5 skip docs/config-only changes regardless of the repo-root-relative path prefix, without skipping code/schema/security changes.
acceptance_criteria: architect_review_check.is_applicable skips a change whose files are only docs/ or config/ even when git returns repo-root-relative paths prefixed with product-forge/; verified by running the gate on a docs-only branch.

The skip_globs in config/architect-review.json match both product-forge/-prefixed and unprefixed docs/config paths; the gate prints OK (skip ...) for a documentation-index.html change and still requires evidence for code changes.
python scripts/dev/precheck.py passes on the docs-only backlog bookkeeping branch and on this config-only fix, while a code-only change still fails closed without Gate 2.5 evidence.
